name: AW Browser
description: AW Browser as a Tier-2 (container) app: a headless Chromium instance from a prebuilt image (ghcr.io/browserless/chromium), started with --shm-size=1g, exposing its CDP remote-debugging endpoint. The aw-workspace runtime spawns the container over the host's rootless podman socket and reverse-proxies it at /api/apps/browser/* (ws://.../json/version, driveable by Playwright/CDP clients). Supersedes the fragile Tier-1 in-process prototype (kept in reference/) which hit 64MB /dev/shm, root-sandbox and apt-less-deps walls.
